subject: Multigroup CFA / Higher order factor structure / Measurement invariance

messages.author: ba47d57acee81a2d
messages.subject: Multigroup CFA / Higher order factor structure / Measurement invariance
parts:
Dear professors

I conduct a multi group CFA, currently with 2 groups (and another group will have to be added later). The scale we use has four factors and two higher order factors, as follows. From the questionnaire, one characteristic is that the questions are once positively (factor 1 and 3)  and once negatively framed (ie. factor 2 and 4). But they build own individual latent factors. 
 
model <- '
factor1 =~ F1 + F2 + F3 + F4 + F5
factor 2 =~ L1 + M2 + M3 + M4 + M5
factor 3 =~ T1 + T2 + T3 + T4 + T5 + T6
factor 4 =~ A1 + A2 + A3 + A4 + A5 + A6

higher1 =~ factor1 + factor2
higher2 =~ factor3 + factor4
'


Problem: My cfa with group = "Group" is not converging properly. However, if I conduct the CFA for each of the groups separately, the model converges. 

The first warning message says:
   " the optimizer (NLMINB) claimed the model converged, but not all
    elements of the gradient are (near) zero; the optimizer may not
    have found a local solution use check.gradient = FALSE to skip
    this check."

I added it to my model fitting, which is simply: 

fit <- cfa(model,
           data = dtall,
           group = "Group",
           check.gradient = FALSE) 
The second error message says:
1: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could
    not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not
    identified.
2: In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative


--> What can I do here? The part that keeps me puzzled is that if I have a look at the covariances, the variances are negative of the factor pairs that have positive and negative connotation (so e.g., between factor 1 and factor 2). 

Thank you for any input on this case.
